about: Public deadlines Upmore can say on its own and on ask (packages/domain/99-deadlines.js; owner's capability list item 39). Read-only: dates only, never what to file, pay or pick. Researched 2026-10-12 by web search restricted to the official sites (irs.gov, cms.gov, medicare.gov, healthcare.gov); the pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment (DNS), so every row says what the official page's search result states and how it was checked. 'date' is the date as the source prints it or, for a tax date the IRS has not printed yet, as the rule sets it; a tax date ('rolls': true) moves to the next business day after a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday (federal holidays and Washington, D.C.'s Emancipation Day), computed in the module and checked against 'published_on' where the IRS printed the year's date. State tax dates differ and the IRS can postpone dates for disaster areas; a person's own plan or employer dates come only from what they say. Re-check every row on its page; past its fresh_days (a year for a federal tax date set by law, 90 days for an enrollment window, the file's fresh_days otherwise) the answer says the dates on file may have changed. Class-action claim dates are not here: no verified settlement list is on file.

roll_rule.text: If a due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday, it moves to the next business day; a legal holiday includes Washington, D.C.'s Emancipation Day (April 16, observed on a weekday).
